restricted_dependencies: Identity-only original reports, historical contract and source-fingerprint records remain private. External PRE-PUSH-008B aliases identify inspected retained temporary evidence, not files promised in delivery. No broad protected manifest content or internal instruction text is delivered.

transformation_rules.description: Select technical fields from structured results; internal reports retained as original identity references, not copied text
Replace exact known original repository root prefix with relative paths and exact retained validation root with a neutral validation-root label; every other transcript byte preserved
Original artifact hashes describe original bytes; transcript hashes describe delivered normalized UTF-8 bytes; output JSON files receive distinct hashes

validation_scope: Source hashes, per-run source manifests/command exits/markers, saved result enumeration, property IDs, IV01 separation, exact allowed transcript substitutions and recursive output confidentiality scan; no tool rerun
